g.text: a What was observed, and what changed?

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24323c

g.text: b Which predictions leave the observed plateau?
Most dilute test: all five worlds, all three arms
Across all 15 campaigns, none of the 180 batches
reached the three dilute test concentrations.
Black line: withheld reference mean Grey: source range

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24323c

g.text: c The advantage of aligned information reverses across test regimes
Other nine tests: 54% lower error vs Opaque. Dilute three: 8.7-fold error. Both directions in 5/5 worlds.
a,b: dissociation response. c: three-response aggregate; five worlds per arm. Groups defined post hoc by public test concentrations.
Reference values were not shown to the agent. No continuous response curve or internal reasoning is inferred from these points.
